The use of colour is important to illustration and graphic design as it makes graphics look more realistic and helps designers create a mood or feeling. Colour also affects the way we feel about and react to everyday things.
Deciding on the most suitable colours for a design is more complex than just choosing your favourite colour.
## Primary, Secondary and Tertiary colours
### Primary colours
These are the three basic colours and cannot be made by mix other colours together.
![Red, Yellow, Blue|500](https://cdn.hackclub.com/01a1c0e2-f49c-7b1e-a6e8-e2daa4b3f8a8/4j6dgq4.png)
### Secondary colours
These are produced by mixing two primary colours together.
![Orange, Green, Violet|500](https://cdn.hackclub.com/01a1c0e4-4e49-79a6-a62d-dba505cf0406/aunfgp5.png)
### Tertiary colors
These are produced by mixing one primary colour and one secondary colours. They take their names from the two mixed colours.
![bunch o colors](https://cdn.hackclub.com/01a1c0e6-0215-7055-9708-aaa33ebfcb64/53o2c4y.png)

**Warm Colours**
